def: A light cape or short cloak of silk or lace worn by women insummer.

Any one of certain class of organic bases regarded as formedfrom ammonia by the substitution of phenyl for hydrogen.

A condition of the body, or mind, when its voluntary functionsare performed with difficulty, and only by a strong exertion of thewill; languor; debility; weariness.The corporeal instruments of action being strained to a high pitch .. . will soon feel a lassitude. Barrow.
Of or relating to the front or forward part; having a positionin front; foremost; as, a front view.
Of or pertaining to Benjamin Franklin. Franklinic electricity,electricity produced by friction; called also statical electricity.
